abstract: Three of four brothers in a family were diagnosed to have testicular tumour. All brothers were in their twenties at diagnosis and all had malignant teratoma, intermediate. One of the brothers, in addition, had a seminoma on the same side as the teratoma. The cases were unusual as there was no family history of cancer and no congenital abnormalities, such as cryptorchidism. Chromosomal analysis and HLA typing did not help in elucidating the cause of this rare familial occurrence of testicular tumour.
abstract_ja: 4人兄弟のうち3人が精巣腫瘍と診断された。全員が20代で診断され、いずれも中間悪性度の悪性奇形腫であった。うち1名は同側にセミノーマも認めた。家族歴に悪性腫瘍はなく、停留精巣などの先天異常もみられなかった。染色体解析およびHLAタイピングでは、この稀な家族内発症の原因は解明されなかった。
